title: When CamAPS reports reports ≤2.2 or ≥22.3 xdrip leaves an empty gap
symptom: When CamAPS reports glucose values ≤2.2 or ≥22.3, xDrip leaves an empty gap in data, with logs showing 'Did not find any matches'.
cause: The value is being read but capped at 400, causing the gap for high values.
fix: Raise the limit in the nightly build; the Sept 2nd Nightly raises this limit, and it resolves the issue.
evidence_quote: I can fix that. Its currently capped at 400 but I will raise the limit. It shows the value is being read properly now though.
